weapons.label: Autopistol
weapons.description: A blowback-operated self-loading pistol. Quick to draw and fire.

weapons.label: Revolver
weapons.description: A double-action revolver. It's reliable, has decent range for a pistol, and is quick on the draw.

weapons.label: Machine Pistol
weapons.description: A fully automatic handgun designed primarily for close-quarters combat.

weapons.label: Submachine Gun
weapons.description: A compact, lightweight, fully automatic weapon designed to be fired from the shoulder or hip.

weapons.label: Assault Rifle
weapons.description: A general purpose weapon for field or urban combat. It has good range, power, and accuracy.

weapons.label: Shotgun
weapons.description: A simple pump action shotgun that can fire either single slug ammunition or a tightly-packed spray of pellets.

weapons.label: Light Machine Gun
weapons.description: A portable, heavy automatic weapon designed to provide continuous suppressive fire.

actions.label: Suppressing Fire
actions.notes: No damage — targets in Area 5 must pass a Defense Roll (DV 15) or be forced into cover.

weapons.label: Breach Axe
weapons.description: A combined blade and tool head attached to a sturdy haft. It excels at tearing through armor and shields.

actions.label: Shred
actions.notes: ×2 vs. Armor — armor is consumed at double rate

weapons.label: Monodagger
weapons.description: A crystal-metallic dagger infused with mechanites that maintain a mono-molecular cutting edge.

weapons.label: Monosword
weapons.description: A crystal-metallic sword infused with mechanites that maintain a mono-molecular cutting edge.

weapons.label: Monowire
weapons.description: A thin piece of wire held between two molded grips infused with mechanites to maintain a mono-molecular sharpness.

actions.label: Garrote
actions.notes: Must target an unaware or Restrained character. Damage goes directly to HP; target makes FOR Save (DV 13) or gains Silenced.

weapons.label: Axe
weapons.description: An advanced form of one of mankind's oldest weapons. The simple design concentrates cutting power from strong overhead swings.

weapons.label: Club
weapons.description: A shaped stick, heavy at one end, for bashing enemies to death.

actions.label: Stun
actions.notes: Target makes FOR Save (DV 11) or gains Dazed.

weapons.label: Knife
weapons.description: One of mankind's oldest manufactured weapons. A handle for holding and a sharp edge for cutting or stabbing.

weapons.label: Longsword
weapons.description: An ancient weapon of knights. Can be used for slashing, stabbing, or held by the blade for powerful pommel strikes.

weapons.label: Mace
weapons.description: A refined club, engineered for efficient swinging and deadly impacts.

actions.label: Stun
actions.notes: Target makes FOR Save (DV 13) or gains Dazed.

weapons.label: Warhammer
weapons.description: A long shaft topped with a brutal hammer. Crush with the head or pierce with the spike on the back.

actions.label: Stun
actions.notes: Target makes FOR Save (DV 15) or gains Dazed.

headgear.label: Simple Helmet
headgear.description: A simple helmet which gives moderate protection against attacks.

headgear.label: Flak Helmet
headgear.description: A lightweight combat helmet with a complex design, reinforced with plasteel.

headgear.label: Recon Helmet
headgear.description: A high-tech armored helmet with a built-in status computer, Tac-Link transceiver, and a protective plasteel-weave plate.

headgear.label: Marine Helmet
headgear.description: A sturdy helmet with a built-in status computer, Tac-Link transceiver, and layered plasteel-weave plates.

headgear_attachments.label: Night Vision Goggles (NVGs)
headgear_attachments.description: Allows the wearer to see clearly in near-total darkness by collecting and amplifying minuscule amounts of light.
notes: Removes the penalties of Dim Light and Darkness for the wearer.

headgear_attachments.label: Tac-Link Transceiver
headgear_attachments.description: A low-profile, multi-band radio transceiver built directly into the inner liner of a helmet.
notes: Allows the user to communicate via radio to fellow team members, 10-kilometer range.

body_armor.label: Heavy Leathers
body_armor.description: A set of clothing made of leather. Offers adequate protection while remaining quite comfortable.

body_armor.label: Flak Vest
body_armor.description: A vest with armor plates inserted on the chest and back.

body_armor.label: Recon Armor
body_armor.description: A suit of light partially-powered armor designed for quick movement. Lightweight plasteel-weave plates with neuro-memetic assistors.

body_armor.label: Marine Armor
body_armor.description: A suit of powered armor. Layered plasteel-weave plates with neuro-memetic assistors allow the wearer to move easier.

armor_attachments.label: Ghillie Suit
armor_attachments.description: A highly specialized camouflage garment designed to make wearers blend into their surroundings.
notes: Gives the wearer Advantage on Stealth tests while in wilderness.
Allows wearer to remain hidden if within 10 spaces of an enemy if they started their turn hidden.

armor_attachments.label: Grenadier Attachment
armor_attachments.description: An integrated frag grenade launcher mounted to the shoulder. Holds 2 frag grenades.
notes: Adds a specialized shoulder-mounted grenade launcher with 2 rounds.

attachments.label: Extended Magazine
attachments.description: Increases magazine capacity so the weapon does not run empty in a single, 6-second burst.

attachments.label: Drum Magazine
attachments.description: Useful for maximum capacity if the user is stationary or defending a fixed point, despite the added weight.

attachments.label: Single-Point Sling
attachments.description: A specialized sling that allows the operator to drop the weapon to transition to a sidearm without losing their primary weapon.
notes: Can drop the weapon for free without losing it.

attachments.label: Detachable Shoulder Stock
attachments.description: Transforms the weapon into a steady platform. The single most important attachment for controlling full-auto muzzle rise.
notes: Requires the Interact quick action to engage or disengage the shoulder stock.

attachments.label: Forward Grip
attachments.description: A secondary grip placed under the barrel to allow a two-handed stance, keeping the muzzle downward during sustained fire.

attachments.label: Micro Red Dot Sight (MRDS)
attachments.description: A lightweight, low-profile optic that allows for rapid target tracking with both eyes open in close-quarters combat.

attachments.label: Suppressor
attachments.description: Quiets the muzzle blast and eliminates muzzle flash. Adds length to compact weapons and requires subsonic ammunition to be fully effective.
notes: Perception tests (DV 11) to notice attacks from this weapon outside range 30.
